android.desc:
Connect-EZ allows you to make free voice calls with just your email address to other people who have installed the app, utilising a data or Wi-Fi connection. Following are some advantages:
Sign up with any email address.
Quickly identify inbound and outbound calls. (No random advertising calls).
No SIM required - works on Wi-Fi*. 
Free phone calls - even International*. 
Free International Roaming*.
Never need to change phone number. 
Native dialer and call history.
Download now and share with your friends.
*Network dependent and data connection required. Please note other party needs to have app installed for free service.
The functionality is confusing some users. You can only call other people's email addresses (not phone numbers). Users with the app can answer calls - otherwise, they will get an email saying you called.
Please feel free to call support at contact@connect-ez.com.
Connect-EZ cannot be used for emergency calling.
